value.rationale: The source singles out the invasion boundary but its unit eigenvalue leaves the nonlinear fate unresolved. An exact unique p* characterizes which side has local extinction versus small-seed escape for every finite round length, and the nonhyperbolic attracting side exhibits a sharp nonexponential 1/n amplitude. The finite-round p* quantifies a real departure from the familiar continuous-time 1/2 transition, a natural gap for synchronous adoption models.
